chunks.l2:
[span-p01-v03] Even in waking and the rest, in difference, it glides in the undifferent; the perceiver-ness never turns back from its own being.

[span-p01-v04] I happy, I suffering, I attached, and the like — those awarenesses plainly abide elsewhere, strung on pleasure-states.

[span-p01-v06] Since the sense-host, deluded, thinks itself undeluded — forthgoing, standing, dissolving, by the inner wheel.

chunks.l2:
[span-p02-v11] Regarding his own nature as presiding, he abides as if smiling — whence, for him, this evil course?

[span-p02-v12] Non-being goes to be-becomeness, and there is no undelusion; since, from contact's application — then thus it was certain.

[span-p02-v14] State-pair, called effect-doer-ness; effect-ness waning there, doer-ness again unwaning.

chunks.l2:
[span-p08-v71] When that ascended measured, from that wasting, life wasting.

[span-p08-v72] Element-sheathed, then freed again — lord-equal, supreme.

[span-p08-v73] Natural, breath-link.

[span-p08-v74] From nose-inside-middle restraint, what here, in left-right-middle channels?

[span-p08-v75] Again may there be re-closing.
